(defn bigdec
  "Coerce to BigDecimal"
  {:tag BigDecimal
   :added "1.0"
   :static true}
  [x] (cond
       (decimal? x) x
       (float? x) (. BigDecimal valueOf (double x))
       (ratio? x) (/ (BigDecimal. (.numerator ^clojure.lang.Ratio x)) (.denominator ^clojure.lang.Ratio x))
       (instance? clojure.lang.BigInt x) (.toBigDecimal ^clojure.lang.BigInt x)
       (instance? BigInteger x) (BigDecimal. ^BigInteger x)
       (number? x) (BigDecimal/valueOf (long x))
       :else (BigDecimal. x)))
implementation: Original Suss function and UTF-16 exact decimal parser; the JVM form is a behavior reference, not a copied Java implementation. Existing Decimal values retain their scale; Doubles use canonical text; integer and Ratio conversions use native exact fields and the dynamic context.
